verdict.rationale: GrowthBook ships its own Proxy, run next to your app, that caches SDK payloads, cuts latency, and keeps serving flags when the API is down. It also offers real-time streaming. Docker self-hosting of the full platform further keeps SDK traffic on your own infrastructure. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of failover behavior, and detailed docs on proxy deployment and network-isolation configuration.
